elevation_list.title: Render the real ledger object in the right pane, untruncated
elevation_list.description: frontend/src/lib/demo.ts readLedger() hand-authors five fields and truncates each with .slice(0,24). The pane would look identical if the contract DID write the amount and the renderer had no amount key, so the judge is asked to trust the renderer. Enumerate the ledger object's own fields, stop truncating, drop the '?? ' fallback on attestations.root().field, and add the two-amount comparison mode Scene 4 now calls for. HIGHEST-VALUE REMAINING CHANGE. Deferred only because it modifies existing frontend behaviour rather than being purely additive (risk=low fails the autonomous auto-approve bar). Full spec in PLAN Task 2b.2.

elevation_list.title: Resolve the trust-versus-privacy contradiction and publish the leakage
elevation_list.description: The pitch sells 'do not reveal the amount to your counterparty'; the shipped bilateral model makes the counterparty the attestor, who must know the amount to compute leaf_hash and can recompute the nullifier. Added PRD Section 1 'Who learns what' and README 'Say the uncomfortable part': the ZK buys privacy from the chain plus a machine-checkable gate, not privacy from the counterparty; that is rung two, and it is credible because prove_funds_in_flight does not change to get there (the circuit never learns which attestor inserted the leaf, so only register_attestation changes). Plus a 'what an observer still learns' table and two structural gaps in 'What is NOT built' (one-shot attestor with no rotation; per-deployment nullifier).

elevation_list.title: De-cluster the close and state the mechanical differentiator
elevation_list.description: Scene 6's closing voiceover said the primitive is 'the same for proving KYC passed, proving reserves cover the book' - the two categories intel killed as saturated (8 identity, 15 credit/solvency) - and tripped Thesis field 6's own drift tripwires by name. README roadmap table did the same in writing. Rewritten onto trade-finance settlement moments (delivery-versus-payment, letters of credit, invoice factoring, zero competitors) with 'Real source-chain attestor' promoted to the first Wave 2 row. Added the mechanical differentiator to both PRD and README: single-use (nullifier), counterparty-bound (leaf binding), expiring (kernel.blockTimeLessThan) - nine tests - making the output a bearer instrument rather than a statement about a balance.

elevation_list.title: Name the product, and correct the stale plan status table
elevation_list.description: The README never explained what 'Aval' means; one line added high on the page (an aval is a third party's guarantee that a payment will happen; Aval replaces the guarantor with a proof), which reinforces the trade-finance frame that keeps this out of the saturated clusters and sets up the Scene 6 close. Separately, PLAN Section 2 marked Phases 3 and 4 'pending' when both are complete, which contradicts a README claiming a working frontend; corrected, with Phase 4 annotated that the build is verified and the in-browser run is not.
